criteria.returns: Exchanges, refunds, wrong or damaged items, and anything about sending a product back.. e.g. These arrived scuffed, can I swap them?; Wrong size, I need a 10 instead of a 9.. not for Late deliveries with no request to return anything, which are shipping.

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, double payments, refunds not yet received, payment method problems.. e.g. I was charged twice for order 4412.; My card was declined but the order went through.. not for Requesting a return; only the money side belongs here.
criteria.other: Anything that fits none of the above, including product questions and partnership mail.
